verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS platform with an 'API and MCP' docs section, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, no evidence documents an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The MCP server and service keys are a different capability and do not count as a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
